name: contradiction_vs_consistency
description: Binary ASNE contrast for matching versus conflicting scene information.

consistent_information.text: A person reads a gate number on a ticket and sees the matching gate number on the display.
Someone checks a package tag and finds the printed name matches the delivery slip.
A person follows the map to room 204 and sees that the door sign names the expected office.
Someone reads the notice by the entrance and sees people using the door named on the sign.
A person checks the schedule and sees the speaker listed in the room printed on the badge.

contradictory_information.text: A person reads a gate number on a ticket while the display shows another gate number.
Someone checks a package tag and finds the printed name differs from the delivery slip.
A person follows the map to room 204, but the door sign names another office.
Someone reads the notice by the entrance while people use a door the sign says is closed.
A person checks the schedule and sees the speaker listed in two rooms for the same hour.
